name: print-social-sport-motivation-posts-with-giant-slogans-behind-athletes
title: Sport pack with giant slogans ('Do It', 'Hit Hard', 'Let's Go') weaving behind athletes on vivid gradients
whatItIs: Nine square posts on saturated gradients (orange, blue, red, green, purple) with huge white condensed slogans set behind and in front of cut-out athletes (basketball player, boxer, runner, footballer), red label bars ('Don't overthink it'), QR codes and small vertical text.
whatItMeans: Explosive and motivating; athletes breaking through type feel powerful and in motion.
techniques: Layer the athlete between letters so they break through the type.
Use a different saturated gradient per post.
Add a red label bar with a sub-slogan.
Include a QR code for engagement.

vocabulary.definition: A subject overlapping some letters and behind others.
